 Houston vs. Colorado prediction, odds, time: Week 11 Friday college football picks from proven model
 SportsLine's model revealed its best bets for Friday's Big 12 college football matchup of the Houston Cougars vs. Deion Sanders and the Colorado Buffaloes
 By
 Daniel Kohn 
 Nov 13, 2026
 at
 8:01 pm ET 
 •
 2 min read
 Imagn Images 
 The 14th-ranked Houston Cougars battle Deion Sanders and the Colorado Buffaloes in a key Big 12 matchup on Friday night as the Cougars look to build their College Football Playoff case. Houston is coming off a 31-24 win over Cincinnati on Saturday, while Colorado dropped a 20-10 decision at Arizona State that same day. The Cougars (7-2, 4-2 Big 12), who are tied for third in the conference, are 2-2 on the road this season. The Buffaloes (3-6, 1-5 Big 12), who are tied for 14th in the league, are 2-2 on their home field in 2026.  Top Houston vs. Colorado predictions
 After simulating Houston vs. Colorado  10,000 times, SportsLine model is going Over 51.5 points at  betting apps  and the best college football betting sites .  The Over hit in last year's meeting. It has also hit in six of the last 10 Cougars games, and in three of the last four Buffaloes games. Houston is the fifth-best scoring team in the Big 12, averaging 35.4 points per game. Defensively, Colorado is 13th, allowing 28.3 points.
 The model projects that Houston quarterback Conner Weigman will throw for more than 240 yards and two touchdowns. He has thrown for 2,280 yards and 22 touchdowns with two interceptions on the season. Colorado quarterback Isaac Wilson, meanwhile, is projected to throw for over 240 yards and one score. He has thrown for 1,412 yards and eight touchdowns with eight interceptions this season.
